4694-6258-7306-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-6258-7306-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

5078-5223-6650-8171.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-5223-6650-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

225-4125-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-4125-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-4125-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Shipwreck Dowser and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

4872-6991-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Donnie & April.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Donnie & April from exile to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2232-7827-7833-7835.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7833-7835.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

997-3234-3946-7776.description:
While Glacial Chasm is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is prevented.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, sacrificing Mortuary Mire.
Resolve the Mortuary Mire trigger, putting World Shaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 3.
Move to your next turn, drawing World Shaper during your draw step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
997-3234-3946-7776.notes: If your life total allows, you can instead opt to pay Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep cost. If you do this, you can forego doing this loop during that turn.

1008-1619-4605-5256-5542.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-4605-5256-5542.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-4605-5256-5542.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2097-4365-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

943-4235-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
943-4235-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting The Core.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and The Core
Repeat
943-4235-6071.notes: With excess mana, you can instead untap another land instead of The Core.

628-2511-7213.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Encumbered Reejerey.
When Encumbered Reejerey dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

3096-3832-4474.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

874-1170-1329-5223.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-5223.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

339-677-3480-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1115-2457-3000-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

301-1099-2169.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2397-4124-5954-6763.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4359-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
3259-4359-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2781-4598-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
2781-4598-4605.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-3519-6122.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3519-6122.description:
Activate Food Chain by exiling another creature you control, adding an amount of mana equal to the creatures mana value plus one that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5670-5708.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-5708.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Vein Ripper and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Vein Ripper and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

222-308-2921-4871.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Saproling.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-308-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1517-2845-3556-4423.notablePrerequisites:
The Mirari Conjecture has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least four Islands.
1517-2845-3556-4423.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on it, and then causing you to copy any instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn and sacrifice The Mirari Conjecture.
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Quintorius Kand and The Mirari Conjecture trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the The Mirari Conjecture trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 4.

643-1806-2034-5072.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
643-1806-2034-5072.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Eternal Scourge's encore ability by paying {3} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Eternal Scourge tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets infinite Eternal Scourge tokens with haste and colorless mana.

974-2100-2472.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2100-2472.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}, targeting any applicable target.
Song of the Worldsoul triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may use Song of the Worldsoul's trigger to target any other token you control instead.

1989-2440-3263-5322.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Spirits.
1989-2440-3263-5322.description:
Cast Haru-Onna by paying {4}.
Kemuri-Onna triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
When Haru-Onna enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Haru-Onna trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Kemuri-Onna by paying {5}.
Haru-Onna triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
When Kemuri-Onna enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Kemuri-Onna trigger, causing target player to discard a card.
Repeat.

1144-1262-4180.description:
Living Lands and Yavimaya cause all lands to be 1/1 creatures that are also Forests in addition to their other types.
Because Drana and Linvala prevents your opponents from activating abilities of creatures they control, your opponents cannot activate abilities of lands or creatures they control.

2816-4360-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Greenweaver Druid.
Greenweaver Druid does not have summoning sickness.
2816-4360-4893.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Greenweaver Druid by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

643-1339-2627.description:
Activate Azami by tapping any creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1623-2034-2302-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Guile, adding {C}{C}.
Guile and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Guile trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Guile, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
